reviewed_by: Claude Code, unblocking supervisor-mode promotions that waited for a busy project to go idle
reason: promote refused to stop the foreground supervisor until every project's chat activity was idle, a rule that exists only for execution workers without #1023 (which fail a turn reading the host while no host runs). A project whose subagents keep reporting never goes idle, so promotion of 111e6da was refused after the bounded wait. The deployer now skips the wait when the API version, every resident execution version and every project owner version are exact commits descending from 445c506 (#1023); any unknown, non-commit or older version keeps the existing bounded wait and refusal. Selected: the host restart and activation-boundary tests (two new activation cases and a real-git ancestry case), the dead-owner acceptance path that bypasses the skip, and the deploy-resume suite that drives activation.
exclusions: No Core, UI or API change; deployer script and its README only. tests/test_simulation_host_activation.py and tests/test_deployer_protocol.py passed locally except one onefile-child identity case that also fails on unmodified main in this environment; test_host_switch_bounds_a_supervisor_that_never_finishes_its_stop and test_host_switch_frees_an_orphan_left_by_a_stop_timeout likewise fail locally on unmodified main (process-signalling environment) and are left to CI.
